description: As compliant, except that key info reports a key created 2 h before the injected now. No other call differs and no restriction reply is invented (C-13.5): the system derives the restriction from createdAt (plan section 10 DC-23).

expected.outcome: 201 with verification passed true and one warning naming the 48 h new-key restriction and its lift time (createdAt + 48 h); the key status stays active, 'restricted' is UI text only; demo orders are accepted; once the clock passes createdAt + 48 h the restriction text is gone.
